test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'WORTH' is written as 'ZRRWK' and ‘TRACK’ is written as ‘WUAFN’. How will 'FAITH' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

Pattern followed here:

**'WORTH' **is written as **'ZRRWK'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0353d39b7d5bf62cca10e1dbc78196f656c25c218e13f4ca46b55d6191c5ddb5.png] 

And,

**'TRACK' **is written as **'****WUAFN'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d0a3d397946a26f50c9e71dad33b37f1daddca70bf7be31562abdccf630244f.png] 

Similarly,

**'FAITH' **is written as **'?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc99539ea03e3df4b108355cd0219ac8d72a7ba3002fc48a9f8d31ac4c85ed0c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IDIWK".**
